The '''Bosthirda system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Worlds]] region of the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bosthirda/Legends|Bosthirda]].<ref name="Revan" />
